input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "solicit" and "shall not" surface no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding AP. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms the Agreement will not restrict AP from offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties. The only "shall not" obligations on AP are content/advertising-standards warranties (p0041, p0044), and the license restrictions in p0002 concern use of Kubient's platform rather than AP's freedom to operate or build competing products. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer); no redline required.
